It stays near zero when the same prepositions introduce an inanimate patient (the description of the building, the destruction of the city, the colour of the sky), a momentary or perceptual agent (mentioned by, seen by, admired by) or a merely possessed object (her car, her house), so the driver is the holder/authority role itself, not the preposition or the token alone.
